description: 1. The agent reads /workspace/SKILL.md and locates the 'Recommended Config' section. 2. It creates agent_config.json with the exact proprietary nested structure: {agents: {defaults: {compaction: {memoryFlush: {enabled: true}}, memorySearch: {enabled: true, sources: ['memory','sessions'], experimental: {sessionMemory: true}}}}}. This is the main proprietary trap — wrong nesting, missing 'experimental' block, or wrong 'sources' type will fail. 3. It creates apply_config.sh containing the exact CLI invocation 'openclaw config patch <json>' as documented (not a generic tool). 4. It reads team/onboarding/agent_behavior_scenarios.json and produces scenario_decisions.json answering S1 (show draft/get approval), S2 (two failures = escalate to user), S3 (read all queued messages before acting), S4 (verify before announcing done) — all drawn from the SKILL.md rules.
